description:
Grounding Essentials is a premium wellness brand specializing in high-quality grounding (earthing) products designed to improve sleep, reduce stress, and support overall wellbeing.
We develop all our products in-house using advanced materials, high-end manufacturing, and strict quality standards — resulting in some of the most durable and effective grounding products on the European market.

Our product range includes grounding bed mats, sheets, pillowcases, yoga mats, and accessories – all engineered to deliver real, consistent grounding benefits.

If your audience cares about sleep, recovery, wellness, biohacking, stress reduction, or natural health, Grounding Essentials is a perfect fit.

 What Makes Us Different

  • High-end grounding products developed in-house

  • Superior materials, durability, and conductivity

  • Rapidly growing brand with high customer satisfaction

  • Strong research-based positioning and premium branding

  • 100% focused on the European market

  • Attractive pricing, high AOV, and strong conversion rates

You will be promoting a premium product line that stands out clearly from low-end marketplace alternatives.


 Commission – Highest in the Industry

We offer a flat 15% commission on all validated sales — one of the highest affiliate payouts in the grounding and wellness niche.

✔ 15% commission on every sale
✔ Industry-leading rates
✔ No tiers, no conditions — just straightforward earnings


Payouts

  • Payout schedule: 1st of every month

  • Hold period: Orders must be older than 45 days to be eligible for payout

  • Payout method: PayPal (mass payout)

This ensures verified, return-free orders and stable monthly affiliate income.


 Who Can Join?

Our market is Europe, so affiliates must have a following primarily in:

  • EU countries

  • Norway, Switzerland, UK

  • European wellness, fitness, sleep, and lifestyle audiences

If your audience is international but includes a strong European segment, that is also acceptable.


How You Can Promote Us

You have complete creative freedom. Affiliates may promote Grounding Essentials through:

  • Social media posts or stories

  • YouTube videos or reviews

  • TikTok content

  • Blogs or articles

  • Email newsletters

  • Discount codes

  • Product demonstrations

  • Wellness, fitness, or sleep optimization content

No strict requirements.
Use your own style, voice, and creativity.


Why Affiliates Love Working With Us

  • High AOV (€177 average order value) → high earnings per sale
    → With our 15% commission, affiliates typically earn €27 per sale

  • Strong repeat customer behavior

  • Fast-growing wellness and grounding category

  • Premium product quality (very low refund rate)

  • Clear communication and consistent payouts


Join Us

If you want to partner with a premium grounding brand and earn industry-leading commissions, we’d love to have you onboard.

Apply now and start earning with Grounding Essentials.
